description: Image Description: The image features a garden gnome statue positioned in a landscaped outdoor setting. The gnome is crafted from what appears to be ceramic or resin and is painted with vibrant colors. It has a cheerful expression, with wide eyes and a broad smile. The gnome wears a green hat, a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, blue overalls, and green shoes. In its right hand, it holds a small orange carrot, while its left hand grips a miniature black shovel with an orange handle.
